author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete
GO:0006627 protein processing involved in protein targeting to mitochondrion -> replace by GO:0070585 protein localization to mitochondrion
GO:0006626 protein targeting to mitochondrion -> replace by GO:0070585 protein localization to mitochondrion
GO:0072655 establishment of protein localization to mitochondrion -> replace by GO:0070585 protein localization to mitochondrion
GO:0090152 establishment of protein localization to mitochondrial membrane involved in mitochondrial fission -> replace by GO:0070585 protein localization to mitochondrion
GO:0090151 establishment of protein localization to mitochondrial membrane insertion into mitochondrial outer membrane (ONLY CAFA has 1 annotation) ->  consider GO:0045040 protein insertion into mitochondrial outer membrane and GO:0045039 protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane

GO:1903214 regulation of protein targeting to mitochondrion -> replace by GO:1903747 regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion
GO:1903955 positive regulation of protein targeting to mitochondrion -> replace by GO:1903749 positive regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion
GO:1903215 negative regulation of protein targeting to mitochondrion -> replace by GO:1903748 negative regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion
GO:1903216 regulation of protein processing involved in protein targeting to mitochondrion -> replace by GO:1903747 regulation of protein localization to mitochondrion

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30349

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EGyxwlTDGV9gUNHuLg9hJ8jjnQf85akiN9K0O2QbvtQ/edit?gid=0#gid=0

CAFA	2
CGD	3

GeneDB	9
HGNC-UCL	3 - P2G group
MGI	5
PINC	9
RGD	9
Reactome	1
SGD	19

UniProt	30

dictyBase	1
ParkinsonsUK-UCL	50  - P2G group

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
GO:0006626	reactome2go	Reactome:R-HSA-1268020 > GO:protein targeting to mitochondrion ; GO:0006626
InterPro:IPR037730 Mitochondrial inner membrane protease subunit 2 > GO:protein processing involved in protein targeting to mitochondrion ; GO:0006627



Thanks.
